tree.heading: Specific Purposes.—
tree.text: The purposes of the corporation are as provided in the articles of incorporation and include—

children.text: bringing into working relations with one another, music clubs and other musical organizations and individuals associated with musical activity for the purpose of developing and maintaining high musical standards;
aiding and encouraging musical education; and
promoting American music and American artists throughout the United States and the world.

tree.heading: Patriotic, Civic, and Historical Organization.—
tree.text: The corporation shall function as a patriotic, civic, and historical organization as authorized by the laws of each State in which it is incorporated.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15150336:2003.Aug. 9, 1982, Pub. L. 97–231, § 3, 96 Stat. 256.
